seed: A sped-up or slowed clip shows its original length beside it (video-speed.html, the Source row over the Retimed one: a dashed, striped ghost bar at the clip's length at 100%). The talking sample at Next defaults, nothing switched. Picked at 100% there is no Source lane. Command R, 50%: the clip doubles and a Source lane opens under it with the ghost at the old length, from where the clip starts. 2x: the clip shrinks and the ghost stays put, now longer than the clip. Picking nothing shuts the lane; picking the clip again opens it; Normal shuts it. Undo brings it back.

steps.comment: Pick the talk on V1 with a click at a point on its face.

steps.note: the talk picked at 100%: no Source lane under it
THE FIRST TEST: Command R, 0.5x. The clip runs twice as long and a Source lane opens right under it: a dashed, striped bar at the clip's old length, starting where the clip starts
THE SECOND TEST: 2x from the Speed dropdown. The clip is half its old length and the ghost has not moved: it now runs past the clip's end
THE THIRD TEST: nothing picked, so the Source lane is shut
THE FOURTH TEST: picked again the lane is back; Normal shuts it, since there is no before and after any more
undo took Normal back: 2x again, and the ghost with it
